get.summary: The trust view of one mailbox, for every member: per category the global evidence, the history result, the trip, the real labels and the verdict (`eligible`, `recommended`, `blocks`); the newest history check; up to 3 examples per moving category (sender name and subject, null after retention). `auto` is `auto` as triage reads it now: a category that is on under another model setup shows off.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Turn on every recommended moving category of a mailbox in one step (owner only). A `shadow` mailbox goes to `assist` with the default switches. The grant is `recommended`. `nothing_recommended`: no moving category is recommended and off; nothing changes, the mode stays.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Queue a history check of the mailbox, reason `web` (owner only). The answer is the queued check. `check_running`: a check of this mailbox is open already.

get.summary: The display name, the signature and the writing style of a mailbox (null: not set), and the texts that stand in for a null: `fallbackName` and `fallbackSignature`.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

put.summary: Set the display name (one line, 1 to 100 characters, none of `< > " @`), the signature (up to 1,000 characters) and the writing style (up to 1,000 characters) of a mailbox (owner only). A key that is left out stays; an empty string clears the field. A text that fails answers 400 `validation`. The answer is the same view as the read.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: One draft on a fixed sample mail, with the unsaved values of the card (owner only). It counts in the daily LLM cap like a tap. At most 10 a day for each mailbox: then 429 `preview_limit`; a second one at the same time answers 429 `preview_busy`. A draft that fails a check, or a failed call, answers 200 `{ kind: "failed", reason }`. 404 while the flag `reply_drafts` is off.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: One suggested writing style from the sent mail of the last 14 days (owner only; the body is `{}`, a key answers 400 `validation`). The text is for the owner to edit and save; nothing is stored but one audit row. 200 gives `{ text, count }` (`count`: the sent mails that the model read); a failed call or a text that fails a check gives 200 `{ kind: "failed", reason }` with `llm_off`, `llm_cap`, `checks`, `output` or `provider`. 409 `sent_off` while sent tracking is off for the mailbox or the organization; 409 `too_few` with the `count` found when fewer than 5 sent mails qualify; 409 `blocked` with `reason` `oauth_mailbox` for an OAuth mailbox. At most 3 runs with a model call a day for each mailbox: then 429 `suggest_limit`; a second run at the same time gives 429 `suggest_busy`. It counts in the daily LLM cap like a tap. 404 while the flag `reply_drafts` or the flag `style_from_sent` is off.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Ask for up to three sample drafts on the newest mails of the last 7 days that need a reply (owner only; any mailbox mode). The answer lists the request ids and their number: fewer than three when fewer mails qualify (0 uses up nothing). A sample is read in the panel; it is never saved in Drafts and never sent. It counts in the daily LLM cap like a tap. One run for each mailbox and quota day: then 409 `sample_limit`. A mailbox of an OAuth provider answers 409 `blocked` with `reason` `oauth_mailbox`. 409 `llm_off` while no model client runs. 404 while the flag `reply_drafts` is off.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

get.summary: The sample drafts of today's run for a mailbox (owner only), oldest first: the status of each request, the subject of its mail and, for a `done` request, the sample text. The panel polls until no item is `pending` or `drafting`. Retention clears the texts. 404 while the flag `reply_drafts` is off.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Accept one suggestion (owner only): the server adds the sender rule through the same validated writer as the Rules page and ends the suggestion. A second accept answers 409 `already` and adds no rule; a full rule list answers 409 `rule_limit` and the suggestion stays open; a sender that is protected now (a delegate, an answer, a rule or a suspicious mail since the suggestion was made) answers 409 `not_available`, ends the suggestion and adds no rule.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Dismiss one suggestion (owner only): the sender and kind stay hidden for 90 days. A second dismiss answers 409 `already`.

get.summary: A random sample of up to 10 unlabelled decisions of one mailbox, for every member (the sample rules of the Telegram /review page: real mail of 30 days, no feedback row, no test mail). Each item holds the category, the confidence, the stored AI summary, the sender's display name, the subject and the date. A new request gives a new sample. `delegation` says whether the organization has an active delegate.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Label one decision with the source `review`, for every member: `verdict: right` agrees with the category, `category` names the true one (`delegation` only when the organization has an active delegate). The same answer twice gives `saved: false`. The label unlocks nothing: it feeds the tripwire and the real-label block only. `needs_category`: `right` on a mail the assistant could not place.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

get.summary: The newsletter senders of one mailbox from the last 30 days, for every member: address, display name (untrusted text), mail count, newest date, the unsubscribe method (`one_click`, `link`, `none`) and the state of an unsubscribe request. A spam or suspicious sender is left out. `linkUrl` (an `https` link) is for the owner only. The route never fetches a link.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: The owner's tap: send one RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe request for one sender of the list. Owner only. The server checks the sender again (not spam, not suspicious, one-click offered by a trusted authentication result) and the target (public `https` host, port 443, no redirect); it sends the fixed body `List-Unsubscribe=One-Click` and nothing from the mail. The answer holds the end state (`done`, `failed`, `refused`) and a short code; the answer of the other server is never stored or returned. A second tap for the same sender gets 409 `already_requested` and sends nothing.

get.summary: Whether Telegram is on, and whether the user linked a chat. `consentVersion` is the consent of the user that an unlink did not withdraw (null: none, or not linked). With the flag `telegram_minimal` on it also holds `detail` (the stored level), `effectiveDetail` (what Telegram gets now) and `locked` (the owner locks `minimal`).

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Record the consent and make a one-time link to the bot. With the flag `telegram_minimal` on, `detail` (full or minimal; a bad value is 400; absent keeps the stored level, which is minimal for a new member) is stored on the membership; `full` while the owner locks `minimal` answers 409 `telegram_detail_locked` and makes no token. With the flag off `detail` is ignored, also a bad value.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

patch.summary: Owner only. Lock the Telegram detail level `minimal` for every member of the organization, or lift the lock. The lock changes no stored member level: on unlock a member who chose `full` gets `full` again. Flag `telegram_minimal`: with it off the route is a 404 for every role.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

get.summary: The own quiet hours, report channel and notice routes. `routes` is the stored choice per group (urgent, approvals, updates: telegram, push or both). `routeDefaults` is where each group goes with no stored choice, for the chat and live push devices of the member. Active mailboxes that can get the report mail.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

patch.summary: Change the own quiet hours (both times, or both null to reset), the own report channel (telegram, mail or both) or the own notice routes (`routes`: telegram, push or both per group; a group not in the body keeps its value, null removes it). One group of keys per body. Quiet hours need `user_quiet_hours`, the channel `report_mail`, the routes `web_push`.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

get.summary: The VAPID public key (null while the server has no keys) and the live push devices of the own user: label, times and whether the device belongs to this session. No endpoint, no key.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

put.summary: Register the push subscription of this browser, or re-bind it to this session. The endpoint must be an https address of a known push service (400 `push_host_not_allowed`). With `rebindOnly` a device that the user does not have answers 404 `no_device` and nothing is stored.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

delete.summary: Remove a push device of the own user. The id of another user or organization answers 404.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Send one test notice to the devices of this session. A device that the push service reports as gone is removed. At most 5 a user an hour (429 `push_test_limit`).

get.summary: The sends that wait for approval or are held after it, newest first, at most 100.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

get.summary: One send in any state, with the text that the committer would send. A send that the system closed (`expired`) names the reason in `endReason`; a reply also carries `redraftsLeft`, `recipientsMode` and, while Reply all is offered, `replyAllAdds`.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Approve a waiting send (owner only). `approved_held` means the send waits for the committer; `heldBy` names the cause.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

409.description: Error codes: changed, draft_not_ready, has_gaps, feature_off, closed

post.summary: Reject a waiting or held send (owner only). The reason is the route postActionRejectReason.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Replace a waiting send by a new version with a new text or delegate (owner only). The new version needs a new approval.

400.description: Error codes: not_editable, unchanged, delegate_inactive, validation

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Ask for a draft reply to one mail (owner only), with an optional line of instruction (1 to 300 characters after cleaning). 202 with the `requestId`: poll `GET /api/replies/requests/:id` every 2 seconds for at most one minute. 200 with the `sendId` when a draft of this mail is open or on its way out. 409 `blocked` names the `reason` (for example `suspicious`, `answered`, `own_mailbox`) and nothing is queued. A line that fails answers 400 `validation`.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Ask for a new version of a waiting reply from one line of instruction (owner only; 1 to 300 characters after cleaning). 202 with the `requestId`. At most 5 redrafts for one mail: then 409 `redraft_limit`. 409 `changed` names the newest version (`currentId`); 409 `closed` names the `state` of a send that no longer waits; 409 `blocked` names the `reason`.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

409.description: Error codes: blocked, changed, closed, redraft_limit

post.summary: Replace a waiting reply by a new version with other recipients and no model call (owner only). `all`: To is the sender, Cc is every other recipient of the mail without an own mailbox (also its `+tag` variants), at most 10; the Reply-To of the mail is never used. `reply_to`: To is the first Reply-To address of the mail that is not the sender. `from`: the sender only. The addresses come from the stored mail, never from the request. The new version needs a new approval: an old Send for the earlier version answers 409 `changed`.

400.description: Error codes: too_many_recipients, no_reply_to, no_others, bad_recipient, unchanged, not_editable, validation

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

get.summary: The state of a request for a draft: `pending` or `drafting` (poll again), `done` (`sendId` is the new version), `superseded` (`sendId` is the draft of the thread that waits now), `no_draft`, `failed` or `cancelled` (`reasonCode` names the cause). Reads the request row; for `superseded` it also reads the open sends of the thread. A request of another organization or one that was not made by a tap or a redraft answers 404.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

get.summary: The delegates of the organization, active ones first, then by name, at most 200.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Add a delegate (owner only). The address is trimmed and lower case. `mailbox_address`: it is a mailbox of the organization.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

patch.summary: Change the name, the tags or the active state of a delegate (owner only; at least one field). The address never changes.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

get.summary: One page of the open loops of one kind (`kind` is required), oldest due first. `filter`: `open` (the default), `due` (open, due by the end of the local day of the organization) or `closed`. `before` is the `next` cursor of the last page. The texts are null after the retention cleared them.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Plan a follow-up of a waiting or delegated loop now (owner only). The follow-up is a draft and a send that waits for a tap in `/approvals`; nothing goes out before the tap. In shadow mode the answer is `would_draft` and nothing is planned. `waiting`: a follow-up waits for a tap or is on its way out. `closed`: the loop is closed. `limit_reached`: two follow-ups are sent. `too_soon`: the last one is less than 3 working days old. `suspicious`: the thread has a suspicious reason. `drafts_off`: the mailbox is not in assist mode with drafts on. `not_allowed`: a promised loop has no follow-up.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

409.description: Error codes: waiting, closed, limit_reached, too_soon, suspicious, drafts_off, not_allowed

post.summary: Move the due date of a waiting or delegated loop 3 working days on (any member). Three times at most: `limit_reached`. `closed`: the loop is closed. `not_allowed`: a promised loop has no Later.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Close an open loop as done (any member). `already`: the loop is closed.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Close an open loop as dropped (owner only). `already`: the loop is closed.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Open a closed loop again (owner only). `already`: the loop is open. `not_allowed`: the loop ended with Sent tracking off, its texts are cleared, or Sent tracking is off.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Stop following a delegated loop (owner only). `already`: the loop is closed. `not_allowed`: the loop is not a delegated one.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Hand a mail to a delegate (owner only): a draft to the delegate and a send that waits for a tap in `/approvals`. The flag `delegate_button` must be on, else 404. `exists`: the mail has an open delegation. `delegate_inactive`: the delegate is off. `drafts_off`: the mailbox is not in assist mode with drafts on. `not_delegable`: the mail is spam, suspicious, from an own mailbox or not triaged yet.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

409.description: Error codes: exists, delegate_inactive, drafts_off, not_delegable

get.summary: One page of the delegations of the organization, newest first. `filter`: `open` (drafted, sent; the default), `overdue`, `answered` or `closed` (done, cancelled). `before` is the `next` cursor of the last page.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Mark an answered or overdue delegation done (any member). `already`: it is done. `not_closable`: it is in another state.

403.description: Error codes: no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Cancel an open delegation (owner only). A drafted one rejects its waiting send; a sent or overdue one expires its waiting reminders. `sending`: its send is on its way out. `not_open`: it is answered, done or cancelled.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

post.summary: Plan a reminder to the delegate now (owner only). The reminder is a draft and a send that waits for a tap in `/approvals`; nothing goes out before the tap. No due-date or 3-day gate. `not_open`: the delegation is not sent or overdue. `limit_reached`: two reminders are sent. `reminder_waiting`: a reminder waits for a tap or is on its way out. `drafts_off`: the mailbox is not in assist mode with drafts on. `delegate_inactive`: the delegate is off.

403.description: Error codes: owner_only, no_organization, org_suspended, bad_origin

409.description: Error codes: not_open, limit_reached, reminder_waiting, drafts_off, delegate_inactive
